title: Integrate four parallel realtime-voice layers against the plan and record requirement retention
derivation: Private T012 realtime push-to-talk slice (plan #246, stacked layer PRs landing as one merge, a cross-layer repair) re-synthesized as a sanitized TypeScript stand-in: a canonical protocol plus three parallel layer outputs carrying realistic cross-layer integration defects (renamed handshake field, protocol version skew, a requirement dropped by a mis-split brief, content leaking into telemetry, a seconds/milliseconds mismatch). No private code, providers, hostnames or credentials are included. v2 (MB-010c follow-up, live evidence): the exact-five ledger check rejected a genuine, fixed memory leak (Sonnet) while correctly rejecting a nonexistent auth bypass (MAI). An independent audit of the landed base (audited_base_defects) found exactly one genuine defect beyond the five integration defects. The ledger now requires the five, admits only audited extras, rejects nonexistent/unknown/duplicate categories, and verifies a claimed leak fix behaviorally; the reference also fixes and lists the leak.
coverage: Integrated end-to-end behavior for all 8 plan requirements, 2 preservation checks and a requirement-retention/defect ledger (closed vocabulary, exact set).
historical_exposure: Private history; synthetic fixture has low recognition risk.
residual_rubric: Quality of integration notes and dispatch follow-ups is not graded.

audited_base_defects.evidence: join sends `room` instead of the protocol's `roomId`
compares against SERVER_PROTOCOL = 1 (line 5) instead of PROTOCOL_VERSION 2
pressTalk returns unless ready, so R5 barge-in/cancel is missing
spreads the audio message, including transcript, into telemetry
budget-ended sessions are flagged but never deleted from the sessions Map (declared line 24, set line 82)

audited_absent.auth-bypass: server.ts:76 rejects unknown tokens; server.ts:43-44 require a joined, non-ended session for every other frame
audited_absent.race-condition: all layers are synchronous and in-process; session.ts sets state before each send
